candidate_relations.scope_detail: Spondylodiscitis at L4/5 is one of the four listed metastatic complications of the pyogenic liver abscess caused by Klebsiella oxytoca; the reference diagnosis requires the primary source (pyogenic liver abscess, Klebsiella oxytoca etiology) plus all four metastatic complications (septic pulmonary embolism, right hepatic vein thrombosis, spondylodiscitis, retroperitoneal abscess).
